an4.20:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.20:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.20:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.20:2.3: Na chandāgatiṃ gacchati . . . na bhayāgatiṃ gacchati.
an4.20:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti.
an4.20:3.3: Chandā ca dosā ca bhayā ca gāmino
an4.20:4.3: Dhamme ṭhitā ye na karonti pāpakaṃ
an4.20:4.4: Na chandā dosā na bhayā ca gāmino
an4.20:4.5: Parisāya maṇḍo ca pan' esa vuccati
